description: Submit a request for human-reviewed terms for a real-world task whose cost depends on scope, feasibility, urgency or conditions. This sends the request into a HumanEndpoint workflow for review by a human operator, but does not commit funds or start execution. HumanEndpoint returns commercial terms that can be accepted or declined before payment. Provide callback_url to receive signed quote.offered or quote.declined webhooks instead of relying only on polling. Suitable tasks include calling a business for current price, stock, lead time or availability; retrieving information only available by phone; verifying a real-world fact; checking AI output; applying human judgement; doing bounded research; or carrying out a physical-world task. If no named service matches, set service_slug to custom-human-task.
name: human_request_quote
title: Request human task quote
